versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the dsl-exit-engine skill with a reusable, three-phase exit primitive for Freqtrade strategies.
- Specifies clear Phase 0 ROI ladder, Phase 1 hard stoploss, and Phase 2 ratcheting trailing stop based on validated backtest results.
- Includes guidance on when to use each phase for different strategy types (mean-reversion, trend-follow, hybrid).
- Provides reference implementation details and example YAML/Python configurations.
- Documents parameter ranges and backtest recommendations for effective strategy tuning.
- Maker-first exit logic included for optimal fee handling with unfilled timeout safeguards.
